```{r params}
# ============================================================
# PARAMETERS — adjust as needed
# ============================================================
BIN_SIZE    <- 50000   # 50 kb resolution (matches windowed analyses)
BUFFER      <- 100000  # ± 100 kb buffer: outliers within this distance are linked
TAJ_D_THR   <- -2      # Tajima's D < threshold → sweep signal
RAISD_QTHR  <- 0.999  # Top 0.1 % VAR scores per chr × population
PIXY_QTHR   <- 0.99   # Top 0.1 % dxy per population pair
SELSCAN_QTHR <- 0.99  # Top 0.1 % |nSL| / |iHS| per chr × population
XPEHH_QTHR  <- 0.995  # Top 0.1 % |norm_xpehh| per chr × pair (two-tail)
MIN_METHODS    <- 2       # Minimum distinct methods required to call a candidate
MIN_BIN_SNPS   <- 50      # Min variants per 50kb bin in the GWAS VCF; below = SNP desert
CHR_START_TRIM <- 200000  # Drop first 200 kb of every chromosome (telomere artefact)

POPS   <- c("uk", "shetland", "norway", "spain")
CHROMS <- c(paste0("chr", 1:14), "chrZ")

# GWAS — path to GEMMA association file (external project)
GWAS_PATH     <- "/Volumes/LaCie/wm-gwas/reports/gwas/wm-gwas.gemma_GLs_filtered.assoc.txt"
GWAS_PVAL_THR <- 0.05   # Bonferroni threshold numerator; denominator = nrow(assoc)
```

```{r helpers}
# ============================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================

# Floor a genomic position to the nearest BIN_SIZE boundary
bin_pos <- function(pos) floor(pos / BIN_SIZE) * BIN_SIZE

# Given a data.table of outlier bins (chr, bin, source, pop),
# expand each bin left and right by BUFFER, then deduplicate
expand_buffer <- function(dt, buffer = BUFFER, bin_size = BIN_SIZE) {
  n_steps <- round(buffer / bin_size)
  offsets <- seq(-n_steps, n_steps) * bin_size
  rbindlist(lapply(offsets, function(off) {
    d      <- copy(as.data.table(dt))
    d[, bin := bin + off]
    d
  }))[bin >= 0] |> distinct(chr, bin, source, pop)
}

# Merge consecutive or touching bins into contiguous regions,
# then collapse method and population metadata across each region
merge_bins_to_regions <- function(score_dt, bin_size = BIN_SIZE) {
  score_dt |>
    arrange(chr, bin) |>
    group_by(chr) |>
    mutate(
      gap      = bin - lag(bin, default = first(bin)),
      new_blk  = gap > bin_size | row_number() == 1L,
      block_id = cumsum(new_blk)
    ) |>
    group_by(chr, block_id) |>
    summarise(
      region_start   = min(bin),
      region_end     = max(bin) + bin_size - 1L,
      region_len_kb  = (max(bin) - min(bin) + bin_size) / 1e3,
      n_support_bins = n(),
      n_methods      = max(n_methods),
      methods        = paste(
        sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(methods, "\\|")))),
        collapse = "|"
      ),
      n_pops         = max(n_pops),
      pops           = paste(
        sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(pops, "\\|")))),
        collapse = "|"
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    select(-block_id) |>
    arrange(desc(n_methods), desc(n_support_bins))
}
```

```{r load_local_pca}
# ============================================================
# 1. LOCAL PCA — population-agnostic; regions already delimited
#    chr values stored without "chr" prefix in this file
# ============================================================
lpca_raw <- fread(
  file.path(reports_path, "local_pca", "pc_outlier_regions.csv")
) |>
  mutate(chr = paste0("chr", chr))

# Drop subtelomeric artefact regions (first 200 kb of each chromosome)
lpca_bins <- lpca_raw |>
  filter(region_start >= CHR_START_TRIM) |>
  rowwise() |>
  reframe(
    chr = chr,
    bin = seq(bin_pos(region_start), bin_pos(region_end), by = BIN_SIZE)
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(source = "local_pca", pop = "all") |>
  as.data.table()

cat("Local PCA: ", nrow(lpca_bins), "outlier bins across",
    uniqueN(lpca_bins$chr), "chromosomes\n")
```

```{r load_tajimasD}
# ============================================================
# 2. TAJIMA'S D — 50-kb windows, per population
#    Flag windows < TAJ_D_THR (negative = sweep signal)
# ============================================================
taj_bins <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
  f <- file.path(reports_path, "tajimasD",
                 paste0(p, "_tajimasD_50kb.Tajima.D"))
  if (!file.exists(f)) {
    message("  [skip] Tajima's D not found for: ", p); return(NULL)
  }
  fread(f, header = TRUE)[
    !grepl("scaffold|mito|unplaced", CHROM) &
      BIN_START >= CHR_START_TRIM &   # telomere trim
      N_SNPS    >= MIN_BIN_SNPS    &   # SNP-desert filter
      TajimaD   <  TAJ_D_THR,
    .(chr = CHROM, bin = bin_pos(BIN_START), source = "tajimas_d", pop = p)
  ]
}), fill = TRUE)

cat("Tajima's D: ", nrow(taj_bins), "outlier bins across",
    taj_bins[, uniqueN(pop)], "populations\n")
```

```{r load_raisd}
# ============================================================
# 3. RAiSD — per-SNP VAR statistic, per population
#    Outliers = top RAISD_QTHR per chromosome × population
# ============================================================
raisd_bins <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
  f <- file.path(reports_path, "raisd",
                 paste0("RAiSD_Report.wm_", p, ".clean.tsv"))

  if (!file.exists(f)) {
    message("  [skip] RAiSD not found for: ", p)
    return(NULL)
  }

  dat <- fread(f, col.names = c(
    "chr", "position", "win_start", "win_end",
    "VAR", "SFS", "LD", "mu"
  ))[
    !grepl("scaffold|mito|unplaced", chr)
  ]

  # Threshold per chromosome
  dat[, thr := quantile(VAR, RAISD_QTHR, na.rm = TRUE), by = chr]

  # Filter + bin
  dat[VAR >= thr & position >= 200000,
      .(chr, bin = bin_pos(position), source = "raisd", pop = p)]

}), fill = TRUE)

cat("RAiSD: ", nrow(raisd_bins), "outlier bins across",
    raisd_bins[, uniqueN(pop)], "populations\n")
```

```{r load_pixy}
# ============================================================
# 4. PIXY dxy — 50-kb windows, between population pairs
#    High dxy = elevated differentiation; flag top PIXY_QTHR per pair
# ============================================================
pixy_raw <- fread(
  file.path(reports_path, "pixy", "pixy_dxy.txt"),
  header = FALSE,
  col.names = c("stat", "pop1", "pop2", "chr",
                "window_pos_1", "window_pos_2", "avg_dxy",
                "no_sites", "col9", "col10", "col11")
)

pixy_bins <- pixy_raw[
  !grepl("scaffold|mito|unplaced", chr) &
    window_pos_1 >= CHR_START_TRIM &   # telomere trim
    no_sites     >= MIN_BIN_SNPS        # SNP-desert filter
][,
  dxy_thr := quantile(avg_dxy, PIXY_QTHR, na.rm = TRUE),
  by = .(pop1, pop2)
][avg_dxy >= dxy_thr,
  .(chr,
    bin    = bin_pos(window_pos_1),
    source = "pixy_dxy",
    pop    = paste(pop1, pop2, sep = "_vs_"))
]

cat("Pixy dxy: ", nrow(pixy_bins), "outlier bins across",
    pixy_bins[, uniqueN(pop)], "population pairs\n")
```

```{r load_gwas}
# ============================================================
# 5. GWAS — GEMMA association (population-agnostic)
#    chr and position are encoded in the `rs` field as
#    "chr1_32797:chr1:32797"; `chr` column itself is -9.
#    Significant SNPs = Bonferroni-corrected at GWAS_PVAL_THR.
# ============================================================
gwas_raw <- fread(GWAS_PATH, header = TRUE)

# Parse chromosome and position from the rs identifier
gwas_raw[,
  `:=`(
    chr = str_extract(rs, "^[^_:]+"),          # "chr1"
    pos = as.integer(str_extract(rs, "\\d+$")) # last integer = position
  )
]

# Bonferroni threshold
gwas_bonf <- GWAS_PVAL_THR / nrow(gwas_raw)
cat(sprintf("GWAS Bonferroni threshold: p < %.2e  (-log10 = %.2f)\n",
            gwas_bonf, -log10(gwas_bonf)))

# Per-bin SNP density from ALL tested variants (pre-significance filter).
# Used throughout to flag SNP deserts: mappability/repeat gaps where any
# signal (elevated mu, negative D, high dxy) is likely an artefact.
snp_density <- gwas_raw[
  chr %in% CHROMS & !is.na(pos),
  .(n_snps = .N),
  by = .(chr, bin = bin_pos(pos))
]
low_density_bins <- snp_density[n_snps < MIN_BIN_SNPS, .(chr, bin)]
cat(sprintf("Low-density bins (< %d SNPs/50kb): %d — excluded from all analyses\n",
            MIN_BIN_SNPS, nrow(low_density_bins)))

gwas_sig <- gwas_raw[
  !grepl("scaffold|mito|unplaced|^-", chr) &
    chr %in% CHROMS &
    !is.na(p_score) &
    pos >= CHR_START_TRIM &
    p_score < gwas_bonf
]

gwas_bins <- gwas_sig[,
  .(chr, bin = bin_pos(pos), source = "gwas", pop = "all")
]

cat("GWAS: ", nrow(gwas_sig), "significant SNPs →",
    nrow(unique(gwas_bins[, .(chr, bin)])),
    "unique 50-kb bins across", uniqueN(gwas_bins$chr), "chromosomes\n")

# Keep the full significant SNP table for the overlap report later
gwas_sig_full <- gwas_sig[, .(chr, pos, p_score, rs)]
```

```{r load_nsl}
# ============================================================
# 6. nSL — per-SNP, per population
#    Outliers = top SELSCAN_QTHR of |nSL| per chr × population
# ============================================================
nsl_bins <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
  rbindlist(lapply(CHROMS, function(chr_name) {
    f <- file.path(reports_path, "selection", p, "nsl", chr_name,
                   paste0(p, "_", chr_name, "_nsl.nsl.out"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
    dat_n <- fread(f, select = c("pos", "nsl"))[
      !is.na(nsl) & !is.na(pos) & pos >= CHR_START_TRIM
    ]
    if (nrow(dat_n) == 0) return(NULL)
    dat_n[, abs_nsl := abs(nsl)]
    thr <- quantile(dat_n$abs_nsl, SELSCAN_QTHR, na.rm = TRUE)
    dat_n[abs_nsl >= thr,
          .(chr = chr_name, bin = bin_pos(pos), source = "nsl", pop = p)]
  }), fill = TRUE)
}), fill = TRUE)

cat("nSL: ", nrow(nsl_bins), "outlier bins across",
    nsl_bins[, uniqueN(pop)], "populations\n")
```

```{r load_xpehh}
# ============================================================
# 8. XP-EHH — per-SNP, per population pair (normalised scores)
#    Outliers = top XPEHH_QTHR of |norm_xpehh| per chr × pair
# ============================================================
XPEHH_PAIRS <- basename(
  list.dirs(file.path(reports_path, "selection", "xpehh"), recursive = FALSE)
)

xpehh_bins <- rbindlist(lapply(XPEHH_PAIRS, function(pair_name) {
  rbindlist(lapply(CHROMS, function(chr_name) {
    f <- file.path(reports_path, "selection", "xpehh", pair_name, chr_name,
                   paste0(pair_name, "_", chr_name, "_xpehh.xpehh.out.norm"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
    dat_xp <- fread(f, select = c("pos", "norm_xpehh"))[
      !is.na(norm_xpehh) & !is.na(pos) & pos >= CHR_START_TRIM
    ]
    if (nrow(dat_xp) == 0) return(NULL)
    dat_xp[, abs_xp := abs(norm_xpehh)]
    thr <- quantile(dat_xp$abs_xp, XPEHH_QTHR, na.rm = TRUE)
    dat_xp[abs_xp >= thr,
           .(chr = chr_name, bin = bin_pos(pos), source = "xpehh", pop = pair_name)]
  }), fill = TRUE)
}), fill = TRUE)

cat("XP-EHH: ", nrow(xpehh_bins), "outlier bins across",
    xpehh_bins[, uniqueN(pop)], "population pairs\n")
```

```{r combine_score}
# ============================================================
# 9. COMBINE ALL SOURCES, EXPAND BY BUFFER, SCORE BINS
# ============================================================
raisd_snp_density <- dat[, .(n_raisd_snps = .N), by = .(chr, bin = bin_pos(position))]
# Then anti_join on bins below your threshold before calling outliers

raw_outlier_bins <- rbindlist(
  list(lpca_bins, taj_bins, raisd_bins, pixy_bins, gwas_bins,
       nsl_bins, ihs_bins, xpehh_bins),
  fill = TRUE
)[chr %in% CHROMS] |>
  distinct(chr, bin, source, pop) |>
  # Remove SNP deserts: bins with < MIN_BIN_SNPS variants in the GWAS VCF.
  # These are mappability / repeat gaps where signals from ANY method are
  # unreliable and would inflate the candidate region count.
  anti_join(low_density_bins, by = c("chr", "bin"))

cat("Total raw outlier bins (after SNP-desert filter):", nrow(raw_outlier_bins), "\n")

# Expand each outlier bin ± BUFFER
expanded_bins <- expand_buffer(raw_outlier_bins)

# Score each (chr, bin) by counting distinct methods and populations
bin_scores <- expanded_bins[
  ,
  .(
    n_methods = uniqueN(source),
    methods   = paste(sort(unique(source)), collapse = "|"),
    n_pops    = uniqueN(pop[pop != "all"]),   # exclude "all" (local_pca)
    pops      = paste(sort(unique(pop)), collapse = "|")
  ),
  by = .(chr, bin)
][n_methods >= MIN_METHODS][order(chr, bin)]

cat("Bins supported by ≥", MIN_METHODS, "methods:", nrow(bin_scores), "\n")
```

```{r merge_regions}
# ============================================================
# 8. MERGE CONSECUTIVE BINS → CANDIDATE REGIONS
# ============================================================
candidate_regions <- merge_bins_to_regions(bin_scores)

cat("\nCandidate regions for selection (≥", MIN_METHODS, "methods):",
    nrow(candidate_regions), "\n\n")

candidate_regions |>
  select(chr, region_start, region_end, region_len_kb,
         n_methods, methods, n_pops, pops) |>
  print(n = 50)

# Save
fwrite(
  candidate_regions,
  file.path(reports_path, "selection", "candidate_regions_multimethod.csv")
)
```

```{r method_comparison}
# ============================================================
# CROSS-METHOD OVERLAP — which methods flag the same regions?
# ============================================================

ALL_METHODS <- c("local_pca", "tajimas_d", "raisd",
                 "nsl", "ihs", "pixy_dxy", "xpehh", "gwas")

METHOD_LABELS <- c(
  local_pca  = "Local PCA",
  tajimas_d  = "Tajima's D",
  raisd      = "RAiSD",
  nsl        = "nSL",
  ihs        = "iHS",
  pixy_dxy   = "Pixy dxy",
  xpehh      = "XP-EHH",
  gwas       = "GWAS"
)

# Binary presence/absence matrix: region × method
method_matrix <- candidate_regions |>
  mutate(region_id = paste0(chr, ":", round(region_start / 1e6, 2),
                            "-", round(region_end / 1e6, 2), " Mb"))

method_flags <- map_dfc(
  setNames(ALL_METHODS, ALL_METHODS),
  ~ grepl(.x, method_matrix$methods, fixed = TRUE)
)

method_matrix <- bind_cols(method_matrix, method_flags) |>
  select(region_id, chr, region_start, n_methods, all_of(ALL_METHODS))

# --- Tile heatmap: regions x methods -------------------------
method_long <- method_matrix |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(ALL_METHODS), names_to = "method", values_to = "flagged") |>
  mutate(
    method    = factor(METHOD_LABELS[method], levels = rev(METHOD_LABELS)),
    region_id = forcats::fct_reorder(region_id, -n_methods)
  )

p_heatmap <- ggplot(method_long,
                    aes(x = region_id, y = method, fill = flagged)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE"  = "#e63946", "FALSE" = "#f0f0f0"),
                    labels = c("TRUE"  = "flagged",  "FALSE" = "not flagged"),
                    name   = NULL) +
  labs(
    title    = "Cross-method overlap — candidate regions",
    subtitle = paste0("Each column = one candidate region  |  n = ",
                      nrow(candidate_regions)),
    x        = NULL,
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text            = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", size = 12),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, size = 7),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey40"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

p_heatmap

ggsave(
  file.path(figures_path, "candidate_regions_method_overlap.pdf"),
  p_heatmap, width = max(8, nrow(candidate_regions) * 0.35 + 3), height = 5.5
)

# --- Pairwise method co-occurrence (Jaccard similarity) ------
# How often do two methods flag the same 50-kb bins?
bin_method_mat <- raw_outlier_bins |>
  distinct(chr, bin, source) |>
  anti_join(low_density_bins, by = c("chr", "bin")) |>
  filter(source %in% ALL_METHODS) |>
  mutate(present = 1L) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = present, values_fill = 0L) |>
  select(any_of(c("chr", "bin", ALL_METHODS)))

method_cols <- intersect(ALL_METHODS, names(bin_method_mat))
jaccard_mat <- outer(method_cols, method_cols, FUN = Vectorize(function(a, b) {
  va <- bin_method_mat[[a]]; vb <- bin_method_mat[[b]]
  both <- sum(va & vb); either <- sum(va | vb)
  if (either == 0) return(NA_real_)
  both / either
}))
dimnames(jaccard_mat) <- list(METHOD_LABELS[method_cols], METHOD_LABELS[method_cols])

jaccard_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(jaccard_mat)) |>
  rename(method_a = Var1, method_b = Var2, jaccard = Freq) |>
  mutate(
    method_a = factor(method_a, levels = METHOD_LABELS[method_cols]),
    method_b = factor(method_b, levels = METHOD_LABELS[method_cols])
  )

p_jaccard <- ggplot(jaccard_long, aes(x = method_a, y = method_b, fill = jaccard)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(jaccard), "", sprintf("%.2f", jaccard))),
            size = 3, family = "roboto_condensed") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = "#f7f7f7",
    mid      = "#f4a261",
    high     = "#e63946",
    midpoint = 0.15,
    na.value = "grey80",
    name     = "Jaccard\nsimilarity",
    limits   = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Pairwise method co-occurrence (Jaccard similarity at 50-kb bin level)",
    subtitle = paste0("Outlier bins only — buffer: +/-", BUFFER / 1e3, " kb"),
    x        = NULL,
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text          = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", size = 12),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey40")
  )

p_jaccard

ggsave(
  file.path(figures_path, "method_jaccard_similarity.pdf"),
  p_jaccard, width = 7, height = 6
)
```

```{r gwas_overlap}
# ============================================================
# 7. GWAS OVERLAP REPORT
#    For each candidate region (± BUFFER), list the GWAS
#    significant SNPs that fall inside it.
# ============================================================

# Build a range table: candidate regions expanded by BUFFER
cand_ranges <- candidate_regions |>
  transmute(
    chr,
    range_start = pmax(region_start - BUFFER, 0),
    range_end   = region_end + BUFFER,
    region_start,
    region_end,
    n_methods,
    methods
  ) |>
  as.data.table()

# Overlap via non-equi join (data.table rolling/range join)
setkey(cand_ranges, chr, range_start, range_end)

gwas_ol <- foverlaps(
  gwas_sig_full[, .(chr, start = pos, end = pos, pos, p_score, rs)],
  cand_ranges,
  by.x = c("chr", "start", "end"),
  by.y = c("chr", "range_start", "range_end"),
  type = "within",
  nomatch = NULL
)[, .(chr, region_start, region_end, n_methods, methods,
      gwas_pos = pos, p_score, rs)]

# Summary: one row per candidate region, with aggregated GWAS info
gwas_overlap_summary <- gwas_ol[
  ,
  .(n_gwas_snps   = .N,
    min_p          = min(p_score),
    top_snp        = rs[which.min(p_score)],
    gwas_positions = paste(sort(unique(gwas_pos)), collapse = ",")),
  by = .(chr, region_start, region_end, n_methods, methods)
] |>
  arrange(chr, region_start)

cat("\nCandidate regions with ≥1 GWAS significant SNP within ±",
    BUFFER / 1e3, "kb:\n")

# Full SNP-level detail
cat("\nAll GWAS significant SNPs overlapping candidate regions:\n")

# Candidate regions with NO GWAS overlap
cands_no_gwas <- candidate_regions |>
  anti_join(
    gwas_overlap_summary |> select(chr, region_start, region_end),
    by = c("chr", "region_start", "region_end")
  )
cat("\nCandidate regions NOT overlapping any GWAS hit:", nrow(cands_no_gwas), "\n")
if (nrow(cands_no_gwas) > 0) print(cands_no_gwas |> select(chr, region_start, region_end, n_methods, methods), n = 30)

# Save overlap table
fwrite(
  gwas_overlap_summary,
  file.path(reports_path, "selection", "candidate_regions_gwas_overlap.csv")
)
```

```{r zoom_plots}
# ============================================================
# 9. ZOOMED MULTI-TRACK PLOTS
#    For every candidate region that overlaps a GWAS significant SNP,
#    produce a stacked figure with one track per evidence source:
#      - GWAS -log10(p)  [always]
#      - RAiSD mu        [if flagged]
#      - Tajima's D      [if flagged]
#      - Pi              [always, as context]
#      - Pixy dxy        [if flagged]
#    Yellow band = candidate region; blue band = local_pca hit.
# ============================================================

ZOOM_PAD <- 2000000   # bp padding either side of the candidate region

POP_COLS <- c(uk = "#e63946", shetland = "#f4a261",
              norway  = "#2a9d8f", spain    = "#6a0572")

# Shared theme for all tracks (x-axis suppressed; restored on bottom panel)
track_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text            = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", size = 11),
    axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# Helpers -------------------------------------------------------
add_highlight <- function(p, rstart, rend) {
  p + annotate("rect",
               xmin = rstart / 1e6, xmax = rend / 1e6,
               ymin = -Inf,         ymax = Inf,
               fill = "#f4d03f", alpha = 0.2)
}

# Main function -------------------------------------------------
plot_candidate_region <- function(row) {
  chr_r  <- row[["chr"]]
  rstart <- as.numeric(row[["region_start"]])
  rend   <- as.numeric(row[["region_end"]])
  meths  <- strsplit(row[["methods"]], "\\|")[[1]]
  zstart <- max(0, rstart - ZOOM_PAD)
  zend   <- rend + ZOOM_PAD
  xlims  <- c(zstart / 1e6, zend / 1e6)

  title_str <- sprintf(
    "%s: %.3f\u2013%.3f Mb  \u2502  %s",
    chr_r, rstart / 1e6, rend / 1e6,
    paste(meths, collapse = " | ")
  )

  # Local-PCA regions overlapping this window (blue annotation bands)
  lpca_here <- lpca_raw |>
    filter(chr == chr_r, region_end >= zstart, region_start <= zend)

  shade_lpca <- function(p) {
    if (nrow(lpca_here) == 0) return(p)
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(lpca_here))) {
      p <- p + annotate("rect",
                        xmin = lpca_here$region_start[j] / 1e6,
                        xmax = lpca_here$region_end[j]   / 1e6,
                        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
                        fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.12)
    }
    p
  }

  panels <- list()

  # -- 1. GWAS (always) ----------------------------------------
  gwas_z <- gwas_raw[
    chr == chr_r & pos >= zstart & pos <= zend & !is.na(p_score),
    .(pos, mlogp = -log10(pmax(p_score, 1e-300)))
  ]
  p_gwas <- ggplot(gwas_z, aes(x = pos / 1e6, y = mlogp)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.8, colour = "#5a798f", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(gwas_bonf),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = xlims, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(y = expression(-log[10](italic(p)[GWAS]))) +
    track_theme
  panels[["gwas"]] <- add_highlight(p_gwas, rstart, rend) |> shade_lpca()

  # -- 2. SNP density (always) — diagnose GWAS deserts ----------
  # Counts ALL tested variants in gwas_raw (before significance filtering)
  # per 50kb bin. A hard drop to near-zero inside the yellow band signals a
  # mappability/quality filter boundary (Pattern 1 artefact), NOT biology.
  # Dense points approaching the Bonferroni line = genuine signal (Pattern 2).
  snp_dens_z <- gwas_raw[
    chr == chr_r & pos >= zstart & pos <= zend,
    .(n_snps = .N),
    by = .(bin = bin_pos(pos))
  ][, mid := bin + BIN_SIZE / 2L]
  if (nrow(snp_dens_z) > 0) {
    p_dens <- ggplot(snp_dens_z, aes(x = mid / 1e6, y = n_snps)) +
      geom_col(fill = "#5a798f", alpha = 0.65,
               width = BIN_SIZE / 1e6 * 0.85) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = xlims, expand = c(0, 0)) +
      labs(y = "SNPs /\n50 kb") +
      track_theme
    panels[["snp_density"]] <- add_highlight(p_dens, rstart, rend) |> shade_lpca()
  }

  # -- 3. RAiSD (if flagged) -----------------------------------
  if ("raisd" %in% meths) {
    raisd_z <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
      f <- file.path(reports_path, "raisd",
                     paste0("RAiSD_Report.wm_", p, ".clean.tsv"))
      if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
      dat_r <- fread(f, select = c(1L, 2L, 5L),
                     col.names = c("chr", "position", "VAR"))[
        chr == chr_r & position >= zstart & position <= zend
      ][, pop := p]
      # Remove SNP-desert positions
      ld_bins_chr <- low_density_bins[chr == chr_r, bin]
      if (length(ld_bins_chr) > 0)
        dat_r <- dat_r[!bin_pos(position) %in% ld_bins_chr]
      dat_r
    }), fill = TRUE)
    if (nrow(raisd_z) > 0) {
      p_raisd <- ggplot(raisd_z,
                        aes(x = position / 1e6, y = VAR, colour = pop)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = POP_COLS, name = NULL) +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = xlims, expand = c(0, 0)) +
        labs(y = expression(μ_VAR ~ (RAiSD))) +
        track_theme
      panels[["raisd"]] <- add_highlight(p_raisd, rstart, rend) |> shade_lpca()
    }
  }

  # -- 3. Tajima's D (if flagged) ------------------------------
  if ("tajimas_d" %in% meths) {
    taj_z <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
      f <- file.path(reports_path, "tajimasD",
                     paste0(p, "_tajimasD_50kb.Tajima.D"))
      if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
      fread(f, header = TRUE)[
        CHROM == chr_r & BIN_START >= zstart & BIN_START <= zend &
          BIN_START >= CHR_START_TRIM & N_SNPS >= MIN_BIN_SNPS &
          !bin_pos(BIN_START) %in% low_density_bins[chr == chr_r, bin]
      ][, `:=`(pop = p, mid = BIN_START + 25000L)]
    }), fill = TRUE)
    if (nrow(taj_z) > 0) {
      p_taj <- ggplot(taj_z, aes(x = mid / 1e6, y = TajimaD, colour = pop)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2),
                   linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.35) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = POP_COLS, name = NULL) +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = xlims, expand = c(0, 0)) +
        labs(y = "Tajima's D") +
        track_theme
      panels[["tajimas_d"]] <- add_highlight(p_taj, rstart, rend) |> shade_lpca()
    }
  }

  # -- 4. Pi (always, as diversity context) --------------------
  pi_z <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
    f <- file.path(reports_path, "pi",
                   paste0(p, "_pi_50kb.windowed.pi"))
    if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
    fread(f, header = TRUE)[
      CHROM == chr_r & BIN_START >= zstart & BIN_START <= zend &
        BIN_START >= CHR_START_TRIM & N_VARIANTS >= MIN_BIN_SNPS &
        !bin_pos(BIN_START) %in% low_density_bins[chr == chr_r, bin]
    ][, `:=`(pop = p, mid = (BIN_START + BIN_END) / 2)]
  }), fill = TRUE)
  if (nrow(pi_z) > 0) {
    p_pi <- ggplot(pi_z, aes(x = mid / 1e6, y = PI, colour = pop)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.85) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = POP_COLS, name = NULL) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = xlims, expand = c(0, 0)) +
      labs(y = expression(pi)) +
      track_theme
    panels[["pi"]] <- add_highlight(p_pi, rstart, rend) |> shade_lpca()
  }

  # -- 5. Pixy dxy (if flagged) --------------------------------
  if ("pixy_dxy" %in% meths) {
    pixy_z <- pixy_raw[
      chr == chr_r &
        window_pos_1 >= zstart & window_pos_1 <= zend &
        window_pos_1 >= CHR_START_TRIM &
        no_sites >= MIN_BIN_SNPS &
        !bin_pos(window_pos_1) %in% low_density_bins[chr == chr_r, bin]
    ][, `:=`(pair = paste(pop1, "vs", pop2),
             mid  = (window_pos_1 + window_pos_2) / 2)]
    if (nrow(pixy_z) > 0) {
      p_pixy <- ggplot(pixy_z, aes(x = mid / 1e6, y = avg_dxy, colour = pair)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
        scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = NULL) +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = xlims, expand = c(0, 0)) +
        labs(y = expression(d[xy])) +
        track_theme
      panels[["pixy_dxy"]] <- add_highlight(p_pixy, rstart, rend) |> shade_lpca()
    }
  }

  # -- 6. nSL (if flagged) -------------------------------------
  if ("nsl" %in% meths) {
    nsl_z <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
      f <- file.path(reports_path, "selection", p, "nsl", chr_r,
                     paste0(p, "_", chr_r, "_nsl.nsl.out"))
      if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
      dat_n <- fread(f, select = c("pos", "nsl"))[
        pos >= zstart & pos <= zend & !is.na(nsl)
      ][, pop := p]
      ld_bins_chr <- low_density_bins[chr == chr_r, bin]
      if (length(ld_bins_chr) > 0)
        dat_n <- dat_n[!bin_pos(pos) %in% ld_bins_chr]
      dat_n
    }), fill = TRUE)
    if (nrow(nsl_z) > 0) {
      p_nsl <- ggplot(nsl_z, aes(x = pos / 1e6, y = nsl, colour = pop)) +
        geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2),
                   linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.35) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = POP_COLS, name = NULL) +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = xlims, expand = c(0, 0)) +
        labs(y = "nSL") +
        track_theme
      panels[["nsl"]] <- add_highlight(p_nsl, rstart, rend) |> shade_lpca()
    }
  }

  # -- 7. iHS (if flagged) -------------------------------------
  if ("ihs" %in% meths) {
    ihs_z <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
      f <- file.path(reports_path, "selection", p, "ihs", chr_r,
                     paste0(p, "_", chr_r, "_ihs.ihs.out"))
      if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
      dat_i <- fread(f, select = c("pos", "ihs"))[
        pos >= zstart & pos <= zend & !is.na(ihs)
      ][, pop := p]
      ld_bins_chr <- low_density_bins[chr == chr_r, bin]
      if (length(ld_bins_chr) > 0)
        dat_i <- dat_i[!bin_pos(pos) %in% ld_bins_chr]
      dat_i
    }), fill = TRUE)
    if (nrow(ihs_z) > 0) {
      p_ihs <- ggplot(ihs_z, aes(x = pos / 1e6, y = ihs, colour = pop)) +
        geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2),
                   linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.35) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = POP_COLS, name = NULL) +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = xlims, expand = c(0, 0)) +
        labs(y = "iHS") +
        track_theme
      panels[["ihs"]] <- add_highlight(p_ihs, rstart, rend) |> shade_lpca()
    }
  }

  # -- 8. XP-EHH (if flagged) ----------------------------------
  if ("xpehh" %in% meths) {
    xpehh_z <- rbindlist(lapply(XPEHH_PAIRS, function(pair_name) {
      f <- file.path(reports_path, "selection", "xpehh", pair_name, chr_r,
                     paste0(pair_name, "_", chr_r, "_xpehh.xpehh.out.norm"))
      if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
      dat_xp <- fread(f, select = c("pos", "norm_xpehh"))[
        pos >= zstart & pos <= zend & !is.na(norm_xpehh)
      ][, pair := pair_name]
      ld_bins_chr <- low_density_bins[chr == chr_r, bin]
      if (length(ld_bins_chr) > 0)
        dat_xp <- dat_xp[!bin_pos(pos) %in% ld_bins_chr]
      dat_xp
    }), fill = TRUE)
    if (nrow(xpehh_z) > 0) {
      p_xpehh <- ggplot(xpehh_z, aes(x = pos / 1e6, y = norm_xpehh, colour = pair)) +
        geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
                   linetype = "solid", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
        scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = NULL) +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = xlims, expand = c(0, 0)) +
        labs(y = "XP-EHH\n(norm)") +
        track_theme
      panels[["xpehh"]] <- add_highlight(p_xpehh, rstart, rend) |> shade_lpca()
    }
  }

  # -- Restore x-axis on the bottom panel ----------------------
  n <- length(panels)
  panels[[n]] <- panels[[n]] +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line()
    ) +
    labs(x = paste0(gsub("chr", "Chr ", chr_r), " position (Mb)"))

  # -- Assemble with patchwork ---------------------------------
  wrap_plots(panels, ncol = 1, heights = rep(1, n)) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = title_str,
      theme = theme(
        plot.title = element_text(
          family = "roboto_condensed", face = "bold",
          size = 12, hjust = 0.5
        )
      )
    )
}

# -- Save individual PDFs + combined file ---------------------
zoom_dir <- file.path(figures_path, "zoom")
if (!dir.exists(zoom_dir)) dir.create(zoom_dir, recursive = TRUE)

if (nrow(gwas_overlap_summary) == 0) {
  message("No candidate regions overlap GWAS significant SNPs \u2014 nothing to plot.")
} else {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(gwas_overlap_summary))) {
    row      <- as.list(gwas_overlap_summary[i])
    meths_v  <- strsplit(row[["methods"]], "\\|")[[1]]
    n_panels <- sum(c(
      TRUE,                         # gwas always
      TRUE,                         # snp density always
      "raisd"     %in% meths_v,
      "tajimas_d" %in% meths_v,
      TRUE,                         # pi always
      "pixy_dxy"  %in% meths_v,
      "nsl"       %in% meths_v,
      "ihs"       %in% meths_v,
      "xpehh"     %in% meths_v
    ))
    p <- plot_candidate_region(row)
    fname <- sprintf("%s_%d_%d_zoom.pdf",
                     row[["chr"]], row[["region_start"]], row[["region_end"]])
    ggsave(file.path(zoom_dir, fname), p,
           width = 10, height = n_panels * 2.5 + 1.5)
  }

  # Multi-page combined PDF
  cairo_pdf(
    file.path(figures_path, "candidate_regions_zoom_all.pdf"),
    width = 10, height = 12, onefile = TRUE
  )
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(gwas_overlap_summary))) {
    print(plot_candidate_region(as.list(gwas_overlap_summary[i])))
  }
  dev.off()

  cat(sprintf(
    "Saved %d zoomed region plots.\n  Individual: %s/\n  Combined:   candidate_regions_zoom_all.pdf\n",
    nrow(gwas_overlap_summary), zoom_dir
  ))
}
```

```{r chr10_top_region}
# ============================================================
# FOCUSED PLOT — top GWAS SNP on chr10
#   Zoom: ± 1 Mb around the top GWAS SNP
#   Low-density bins (< 80 SNPs/50kb) removed & gaps collapsed
# ============================================================

chr_r10    <- "chr10"
focal_pad  <- 1000000L
MIN_DENSITY <- 80L   # SNPs per 50kb bin threshold

# --- 1) Find the top GWAS SNP on chr10 ----------------------
chr10_top <- gwas_raw[
  chr == chr_r10 & !is.na(p_score)
][order(p_score)][1]

if (nrow(chr10_top) == 0) stop("No GWAS SNPs found on chr10.")

focal_pos   <- as.numeric(chr10_top$pos)
focal_start <- max(0L, focal_pos - focal_pad)
focal_end   <- focal_pos + focal_pad

cat(sprintf(
  "chr10 top GWAS SNP: %s:%d  (p = %s)\n",
  chr_r10, focal_pos,
  formatC(chr10_top$p_score, format = "e", digits = 2)
))

# --- 2) Build density map & identify kept bins ---------------
snp_density_full <- gwas_raw[
  chr == chr_r10 & pos >= focal_start & pos <= focal_end,
  .(n_snps = .N),
  by = .(bin = bin_pos(pos))
][order(bin)]

kept_bins <- snp_density_full[n_snps >= MIN_DENSITY, bin]

# For every position, which bin does it fall in?
in_kept_bin <- function(pos_vec) {
  bin_pos(pos_vec) %in% kept_bins
}

# --- 3) Build a collapsed x-axis ----------------------------
# Each kept bin gets a sequential index; we map physical pos → index space
# Bin midpoints in order
kept_bin_mids <- kept_bins + BIN_SIZE / 2L

# Map a physical position vector to collapsed x coordinates
# (linear interpolation within each bin, bins laid end-to-end)
phys_to_collapsed <- function(pos_vec) {
  b   <- bin_pos(pos_vec)                     # which bin
  off <- (pos_vec - b) / BIN_SIZE             # 0–1 offset within bin
  idx <- match(b, kept_bins)                  # sequential bin index (1-based)
  (idx - 1L + off)                            # collapsed coordinate
}

n_kept <- length(kept_bins)

# Build x-axis break labels (physical Mb) at ~10 evenly-spaced kept bins
label_idx  <- round(seq(1, n_kept, length.out = min(10L, n_kept)))
label_x    <- label_idx - 0.5                # collapsed coord at bin centre
label_text <- sprintf("%.2f", kept_bin_mids[label_idx] / 1e6)

collapsed_scale <- list(
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = label_x,
    labels = label_text,
    expand = c(0.01, 0)
  ),
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, n_kept))
)

# Collapsed x for the focal SNP (for highlight)
focal_collapsed <- phys_to_collapsed(focal_pos)

# --- 4) Shading helpers (collapsed coords) -------------------
lpca_focal <- lpca_raw |>
  dplyr::filter(
    chr == chr_r10,
    region_end   >= focal_start,
    region_start <= focal_end
  )

shade_lpca_focal <- function(p) {
  if (nrow(lpca_focal) == 0) return(p)
  for (j in seq_len(nrow(lpca_focal))) {
    # find kept bins that overlap this LPCA region
    overlap_bins <- kept_bins[
      kept_bins + BIN_SIZE >= lpca_focal$region_start[j] &
      kept_bins             <= lpca_focal$region_end[j]
    ]
    if (length(overlap_bins) == 0) next
    idx_start <- match(min(overlap_bins), kept_bins) - 1L
    idx_end   <- match(max(overlap_bins), kept_bins)
    p <- p + annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = idx_start, xmax = idx_end,
      ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
      fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.12
    )
  }
  p
}

decorate <- function(p) {
  shade_lpca_focal(p)
}

# --- 5) Build panels -----------------------------------------
p10 <- list()

# 5.1 GWAS
gwas_10 <- gwas_raw[
  chr == chr_r10 & pos >= focal_start & pos <= focal_end & !is.na(p_score)
][in_kept_bin(pos)][
  , .(cx = phys_to_collapsed(pos), mlogp = -log10(pmax(p_score, 1e-300)))
]

p10[["gwas"]] <- (
  ggplot(gwas_10, aes(x = cx, y = mlogp)) +
    geom_point(size = 1, colour = "#5a798f", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(gwas_bonf),
               linetype = "dashed", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
    collapsed_scale +
    labs(y = expression(-log[10](italic(p)[GWAS]))) +
    track_theme
) |> decorate()

# 5.2 SNP density (only kept bins, no gaps)
snp_10 <- snp_density_full[bin %in% kept_bins][
  , cx := phys_to_collapsed(bin + BIN_SIZE / 2L)
]

p10[["snp_density"]] <- (
  ggplot(snp_10, aes(x = cx, y = n_snps)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#5a798f", alpha = 0.65, width = 0.85) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = MIN_DENSITY,
               linetype = "dotted", colour = "red", linewidth = 0.4) +
    collapsed_scale +
    labs(y = "SNPs /\n50 kb") +
    track_theme
) |> decorate()

# 5.3 RAiSD
raisd_10 <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
  f <- file.path(reports_path, "raisd",
                 paste0("RAiSD_Report.wm_", p, ".clean.tsv"))
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  dat <- fread(f, select = c(1L, 2L, 5L),
               col.names = c("chr", "position", "VAR"))[
    chr == chr_r10 & position >= focal_start & position <= focal_end
  ][in_kept_bin(position)][, `:=`(pop = p, cx = phys_to_collapsed(position))]
  dat
}), fill = TRUE)

if (nrow(raisd_10) > 0) {
  p10[["raisd"]] <- (
    ggplot(raisd_10, aes(x = cx, y = VAR, colour = pop)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = POP_COLS, name = NULL) +
      collapsed_scale +
      labs(y = expression(mu[VAR] ~ (RAiSD))) +
      track_theme
  ) |> decorate()
}

# 5.4 Tajima's D
taj_10 <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
  f <- file.path(reports_path, "tajimasD",
                 paste0(p, "_tajimasD_50kb.Tajima.D"))
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  dat <- fread(f, header = TRUE)[
    CHROM == chr_r10 & BIN_START >= focal_start & BIN_START <= focal_end &
    BIN_START >= CHR_START_TRIM & N_SNPS >= MIN_BIN_SNPS
  ][in_kept_bin(BIN_START)][
    , `:=`(pop = p, cx = phys_to_collapsed(BIN_START + 25000L))
  ]
  dat
}), fill = TRUE)

if (nrow(taj_10) > 0) {
  p10[["tajimas_d"]] <- (
    ggplot(taj_10, aes(x = cx, y = TajimaD, colour = pop)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2),
                 linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.35) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = POP_COLS, name = NULL) +
      collapsed_scale +
      labs(y = "Tajima's D") +
      track_theme
  ) |> decorate()
}

# 5.5 Pi
pi_10 <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
  f <- file.path(reports_path, "pi",
                 paste0(p, "_pi_50kb.windowed.pi"))
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)
  dat <- fread(f, header = TRUE)[
    CHROM == chr_r10 & BIN_START >= focal_start & BIN_START <= focal_end &
    BIN_START >= CHR_START_TRIM & N_VARIANTS >= MIN_BIN_SNPS
  ][in_kept_bin(BIN_START)][
    , `:=`(pop = p, cx = phys_to_collapsed((BIN_START + BIN_END) / 2))
  ]
  dat
}), fill = TRUE)

if (nrow(pi_10) > 0) {
  p10[["pi"]] <- (
    ggplot(pi_10, aes(x = cx, y = PI, colour = pop)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.85) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = POP_COLS, name = NULL) +
      collapsed_scale +
      labs(y = expression(pi)) +
      track_theme
  ) |> decorate()
}

# 5.6 Pixy dxy
pixy_10 <- pixy_raw[
  chr == chr_r10 & window_pos_1 >= focal_start & window_pos_1 <= focal_end &
  window_pos_1 >= CHR_START_TRIM & no_sites >= MIN_BIN_SNPS
][in_kept_bin(window_pos_1)][
  , `:=`(
    pair = paste(pop1, "vs", pop2),
    cx   = phys_to_collapsed((window_pos_1 + window_pos_2) / 2)
  )
]

if (nrow(pixy_10) > 0) {

  ) |> decorate()
}

# 5.7 nSL
nsl_10 <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
  f <- file.path(reports_path, "selection", p, "nsl", chr_r10,
                 paste0(p, "_", chr_r10, "_nsl.nsl.out"))
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NULL)

    pos >= focal_start & pos <= focal_end & !is.na(nsl)
  ][in_kept_bin(pos)][, `:=`(pop = p, cx = phys_to_collapsed(pos))]
  dat
}), fill = TRUE)

if (nrow(nsl_10) > 0) {
  p10[["nsl"]] <- (
    ggplot(nsl_10, aes(x = cx, y = nsl, colour = pop)) +

      labs(y = "nSL") +

}

# 5.8 iHS
ihs_10 <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS, function(p) {
  f <- file.path(reports_path, "selection", p, "ihs", chr_r10,
                 paste0(p, "_", chr_r10, "_ihs.ihs.out"))

    pos >= focal_start & pos <= focal_end & !is.na(ihs)

}), fill = TRUE)

if (nrow(ihs_10) > 0) {
  p10[["ihs"]] <- (
    ggplot(ihs_10, aes(x = cx, y = ihs, colour = pop)) +

# 5.9 XP-EHH
xpehh_10 <- rbindlist(lapply(XPEHH_PAIRS, function(pair_name) {
  f <- file.path(reports_path, "selection", "xpehh", pair_name, chr_r10,
                 paste0(pair_name, "_", chr_r10, "_xpehh.xpehh.out.norm"))

if (nrow(xpehh_10) > 0) {

# --- 6) Restore x-axis on bottom panel ----------------------
if (length(p10) == 0) stop("No tracks were created for the chr10 focal region.")

n10      <- length(p10)
p10[[n10]] <- p10[[n10]] +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line()

  "Chr10 top GWAS SNP: %.3f Mb  |  ±1 Mb zoom  |  SNP density ≥ %d /50kb  |  %s",
  focal_pos / 1e6, MIN_DENSITY,

p_chr10_all <- wrap_plots(p10, ncol = 1, heights = rep(1, n10)) +
```

```{r per_population}
# ============================================================
# 9. PER-POPULATION BREAKDOWN
#    For each population: how many of the within-pop methods
#    (TajD + RAiSD) flag the region, and is it also a local_pca hit?
# ============================================================

# Expand pop-specific and local_pca bins separately
pop_expanded   <- expand_buffer(rbindlist(list(taj_bins, raisd_bins, nsl_bins, ihs_bins), fill = TRUE))
lpca_expanded  <- expand_buffer(lpca_bins) |> distinct(chr, bin) |> mutate(local_pca = TRUE)
pixy_expanded  <- expand_buffer(rbindlist(list(pixy_bins, xpehh_bins), fill = TRUE))
gwas_expanded  <- expand_buffer(gwas_bins) |> distinct(chr, bin) |> mutate(gwas_hit  = TRUE)

per_pop_candidates <- lapply(POPS, function(p) {
  # Within-pop score (TajD + RAiSD + nSL + iHS)
  within_pop <- pop_expanded[pop == p,
    .(n_within_methods = uniqueN(source),
      within_methods   = paste(sort(unique(source)), collapse = "|")),
    by = .(chr, bin)
  ]

  # pixy + xpehh pairs involving this population
  pixy_pop <- pixy_expanded[grepl(p, pop),
    .(pixy_hit = TRUE),
    by = .(chr, bin)
  ] |> distinct(chr, bin, pixy_hit)

  within_pop |>
    left_join(lpca_expanded, by = c("chr", "bin")) |>
    left_join(pixy_pop,      by = c("chr", "bin")) |>
    left_join(gwas_expanded, by = c("chr", "bin")) |>
    mutate(
      local_pca     = coalesce(local_pca, FALSE),
      pixy_hit      = coalesce(pixy_hit,  FALSE),
      gwas_hit      = coalesce(gwas_hit,  FALSE),
      total_methods = n_within_methods + local_pca + pixy_hit + gwas_hit,
      pop = p
    ) |>
    filter(total_methods >= MIN_METHODS)
}) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  as.data.table()

# Merge into regions per population
per_pop_regions <- per_pop_candidates |>
  group_by(pop, chr) |>
  arrange(pop, chr, bin) |>
  mutate(
    gap      = bin - lag(bin, default = first(bin)),
    new_blk  = gap > BIN_SIZE | row_number() == 1L,
    block_id = cumsum(new_blk)
  ) |>
  group_by(pop, chr, block_id) |>
  summarise(
    region_start      = min(bin),
    region_end        = max(bin) + BIN_SIZE - 1L,
    region_len_kb     = (max(bin) - min(bin) + BIN_SIZE) / 1e3,
    n_support_bins    = n(),
    max_total_methods = max(total_methods),
    has_local_pca     = any(local_pca),
    has_pixy          = any(pixy_hit),
    has_gwas          = any(gwas_hit),
    within_methods    = paste(
      sort(unique(unlist(strsplit(within_methods, "\\|")))), collapse = "|"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  select(-block_id) |>
  arrange(pop, desc(max_total_methods), desc(n_support_bins))

cat("\nPer-population candidate regions:\n")
per_pop_regions |> print(n = 50)

fwrite(
  per_pop_regions,
  file.path(reports_path, "selection", "candidate_regions_per_population.csv")
)
```

```{r visualise_global}
# ============================================================
# 10. VISUALISATION — genome-wide overview of candidate regions
# ============================================================

# Chromosome lengths from RAiSD (use as proxy for genome layout)
chr_lengths <- rbindlist(lapply(POPS[1], function(p) {
  f <- file.path(reports_path, "raisd",
                 paste0("RAiSD_Report.wm_", p, ".clean.tsv"))
  fread(f, select = c(1L, 2L, 5L),
        col.names = c("chr", "position", "VAR"))[
    !grepl("scaffold|mito|unplaced", chr),
    .(chr_len = max(position)),
    by = chr
  ]
}))[chr %in% CHROMS] |>
  distinct(chr, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(chr_num = as.integer(str_extract(chr, "\\d+"))) |>
  arrange(chr_num, chr) |>
  mutate(
    chr      = factor(chr, levels = chr),
    offset   = lag(cumsum(as.numeric(chr_len) + 1e6), default = 0),
    center   = offset + chr_len / 2
  )

# Add genome-wide coordinates to candidate regions
candidates_plot <- candidate_regions |>
  mutate(
    chr      = factor(chr, levels = levels(chr_lengths$chr)),
    has_gwas = grepl("gwas", methods)
  ) |>
  left_join(chr_lengths |> select(chr, offset), by = "chr") |>
  mutate(
    gstart = region_start + offset,
    gend   = region_end   + offset,
    gmid   = (gstart + gend) / 2
  )

ggplot(candidates_plot) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = gstart, xend = gend,
        y = n_methods, yend = n_methods,
        colour = factor(n_methods)),
    linewidth = 3, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  # Star marker above GWAS-supported regions
  geom_point(
    data = candidates_plot |> filter(has_gwas),
    aes(x = gmid, y = n_methods + 0.4),
    shape = 8, size = 2.5, colour = "#2d3436", stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = gmid, y = n_methods + 0.15,
        label = paste0(chr, ":", round(region_start / 1e6, 1), "Mb")),
    size = 2.5, angle = 45, hjust = 0, family = "roboto_condensed"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = chr_lengths$center,
    labels = gsub("chr", "", chr_lengths$chr),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:5, limits = c(0.5, 6)) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("2" = "#aec6cf", "3" = "#f4a261", "4" = "#e63946", "5" = "#6a0572"),
    name   = "Methods\nsupporting"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Candidate regions for selection — multi-method support",
    subtitle = paste0("Buffer: \u00b1", BUFFER / 1e3, " kb | Min methods: ", MIN_METHODS,
                      " | SNP deserts (<", MIN_BIN_SNPS, " SNPs/50kb) removed",
                      " | \u2605 = GWAS support"),
    x        = "Chromosome",
    y        = "Number of methods"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.line        = element_line(color = "black"),
    text             = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed", size = 14),
    legend.position  = "right",
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(figures_path, "candidate_regions_multimethod.pdf"),
  width = 18, height = 5
)
```
